content: Mmis yuɛřa aṭṭas x lmalakat
Deg wussan iɛdun issiweř AREBBI di kuř řweqt u deg waṭṭas n ibriden ak-d řejdud nneɣ s inabiyyen.
Deg wussan-a ineggura aqa issiweř-dd akidneɣ s Mmis, wenni igga d Awrit n kuřci, s Wenni ɛawed igga zzmanat.

Minzi Netta d talellect n uɛuǧi nnes uřa d tteswirt n Simant nnes, u Netta d wenni yarebbun marra timesřayin s jjehd n Wawař nnes. Aqa Netta issizdeg ddnub nneɣ di ṭṭbiɛet n Yixef nnes, uca iruḥ iqqim ɣar yefus n Lɛaḍim di řuɛřa.
Netta yuɛřa aṭṭas x lmalakat am Isem i iṭṭef d řwart, aqa icna x wenni nsen.
Minzi i man ten zi lmalakat inna AREBBI:
“Mmi i teǧid Cek, ass-a Necc jjiɣ-dd Cek!”,
uca ɛawed inna:
“Necc ad as iřiɣ d Babas u Netta ad ayi yiři d Mmi”?
Uca xenni xmi dd-issidef Amenzu ɣar ddunect, inna:
“Ad as sejdent marra lmalakat n AREBBI.”
Maca x lmalakat inna:
“Netta igga lmalakat nnes d isemmiḍen, uca imsexxaren nnes d ict n tmessi itteḥduduqen”,
Maca x Mmis:
“Řɛarc nnec, a AREBBI, aqa iǧa i řebda qaɛ. Azeǧaḍ n Tgeldit nnec, aqa-tt d azeǧaḍ iseggden.
Aqa texsed tasegda, tcarhed řɣar. S uyenni aqa idhen i c AREBBI, AREBBI nnec, s zzect n řefraḥet sennej i imɛacaren nnec.”
Uca xenni:
“Zeg ubeddu teggid Cek dsas n temmurt, ijenwan ǧan d řxedmet n ifassen nnec.
Ina ad ttwateḥḥan, maca Cek ad tdumed, uca ina marra ad arcan am warruḍ.
Amecnaw ijj n useřham ad ten ttḍefsed. Ad ttwabeddřen am warruḍ, maca Cek ad tiřid d wenni uca iseggʷusa nnec war qeṭṭin ca.”
Maca i man ten zi lmalakat inna ijj n wass:
“Qqim ɣar yefus inu ař d ɣa ggeɣ řɛedyan nnec d tanebdat sadu iḍaren nnec”?
Ma war ǧint nitenti d arruḥat i tsexxart, ttwassekkent-i-dd ḥima ad sexxarent i yinni ɣa iwarten Tudart?
